items.exemplar:
A. Hoover created the Reconstruction Finance Corporation (1932) to lend to banks and businesses, breaking with pure voluntarism.

B. Roosevelt's Hundred Days vastly expanded Washington: the AAA, CCC, TVA, and FDIC put the federal government into farming, employment, power, and banking.

C. Resistance came from both sides: business leaders denounced the New Deal as socialism (the Liberty League), while the Supreme Court struck down the NRA and AAA in 1935–36.
parts: A. Briefly explain ONE way government expanded to combat the Great Depression.
B. Briefly explain a SECOND example of that expansion.
C. Briefly explain ONE example of resistance to the expansion of government in the 1930s.
items.stimulus: Historian William Leuchtenburg argues the New Deal 'vastly enlarged the power of the presidency and the scope of federal responsibility' — a revolution in government's role that both major parties would spend the rest of the century debating.
